# Text Extraction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TextExtraction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The text content extracted from a source object (e.g. a PDF attachment), linked to its source by [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md). A faithful (ideally verbatim) rendering of the source's textual content, distinct from a [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md), which condenses and is therefore lossy.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the text content pulled verbatim out of a source object — OCR or extraction from a PDF, image, or binary attachment — whose lineage to that source must be recorded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a condensed or paraphrased account (use [`gmeow:Summary`](gmeow-Summary.md)) and for the source document itself; a [`TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md) is the derived text view, not the original artifact.

### How to use

- Type the extracted text as [`gmeow:TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md), link it to its source with [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md), and name the extracting activity via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md); record extraction confidence (OCR quality) on the statement layer.

### Examples

- ex:pdfText a [`gmeow:TextExtraction`](gmeow-TextExtraction.md); [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) ex:pdfAttachment.
